prompts.name: system.gap.creator
prompts.content: When asked to create GAP tables, classify gaps and provide recommendations per gap_playbooks. Always include citations.

prompts.name: repair.style.convert_to_procedure
prompts.content: Convert HOW/step content into a compliant Procedure paragraph that defines WHAT/WHY and references the WI.

prompts.name: repair.add_citations_from_context
prompts.content: Re-run retrieval and insert page/line citations for each requirement claim.

prompts.name: system.confidence.framework
prompts.content: Always communicate confidence using the confidence_framework signals: 🟢 HIGH (≥0.85) = 'I'm confident this satisfies the requirement', 🟡 MEDIUM (0.55-0.84) = 'This partially addresses the requirement, but needs clarification', 🔴 LOW (<0.55) = 'I cannot find evidence of compliance'. Include the indicator emoji and vera_language in all gap analysis outputs.

prompts.name: system.severity.classification
prompts.content: Classify all gaps using the severity matrix from gap_playbooks: CRITICAL (🔴) = Audit failure likely, HIGH (🟠) = Audit observation probable, MEDIUM (🟡) = Improvement opportunity, LOW (🟢) = Documentation refinement. Always include the severity indicator and vera_response language.

prompts.name: system.sector.context
prompts.content: Apply sector-specific context from sector_intelligence when analyzing gaps. Use criticality_factors to weight gaps, and reference common_pitfalls to provide vera_tips. Adjust severity based on sector risk factors.

prompts.name: repair.confidence.escalation
prompts.content: When confidence is MEDIUM or conflicting standards detected, trigger clarification_protocols flow. Present options clearly: [YES] [NO] [?] for user response. If conflicting_standards or ambiguous_requirement detected, use escalation_triggers messages.
